newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani sugar mills output slows.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani sugar mills output slows.

text.p: The Pakistan Sugar Mills Association said on Thursday sugar output was 28,480 tonnes in the fortnight ended November 15 of the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year compared to 161,246 tonnes in the year-ago period.
It said the drop was due to the late start of sugarcane crushing, which one mill owner said started on November 1 this year, a month later than in 1995.
Pakistan is likely to produce 2.7 million tonnes in 1996/97, compared to 2.47 million in 1995/96 and 3.0 million in 1994/95.
